# `Q-2-11` — Unclosed Double Quote

> A double-quoted construct opens with `"` but no closing `"`
> appears before the end of the block.

## What this means

Quarto markdown recognizes `"…"` as a typographic double-quote
pair when the quotes are balanced within a block. This error
fires when an opening `"` has no matching close.

## Why this happens

A missed closing quote in a hand-written passage, or a passage
where the closing quote was deleted by an edit but the opener
left behind.

## How to fix

Add the closing `"` at the intended end, or escape literal
double quotes that the parser is mis-reading:

```markdown
He said \"this is verbatim\".
```

## Example

```markdown
a" b.
```
